decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already requires randomly allocated commissions to appear on the dashboard and in NFT attributes, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.

The client conditionally allows no-referral purchases to generate no ticket but does not determine whether tickets are actually generated; changing the current one-ticket-per-primary-mint accounting rule requires clarification.
Displaying randomly allocated commissions does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source changes visibility of randomly allocated commissions, not public referral-count statistics.
Commission visibility does not alter the requirement to display recorded referral counts.
The requested commission attribute is structured reward data and does not change NFT image or media rendering behavior.
The source does not change the counting basis or presentation of public mint statistics.
Displaying a randomly allocated commission does not change public prize-pool totals or their accuracy.
The commission-display decision does not change the next-draw countdown label or sales-remaining measure.

The current FAQ says no-referral mints randomly allocate both commissions and tickets, while the source conditionally permits generating no ticket; a finalized ticket policy is needed before safely revising the FAQ.
The source changes where randomly allocated commissions must be displayed, not their amount, allocation condition, or random-recipient rule.
The client reopens whether a no-referral purchase must generate a ticket but does not select a definitive policy, so the active random-ticket allocation state cannot be safely modified.
